abilities.name: Creep Tumor
abilities.description: Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors last 240 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active. Stores up to 3 charges. Creep Tumor ; 18 / 3; trait

fields.notes: Creep grows to its maximum radius over 6 seconds. Creep areas can overlap, but Creep Tumors cannot be placed exactly on top of each other. Creep Tumors become Invisible after 2 seconds of being placed. Damaging Creep Tumors reveals them for 2 seconds. Sight radius increases to 8.5 when the Creep Tumor turns invisible. Creep Tumors are permanently Unstoppable, immune to skillshots and friendly Abilities and do not draw Minion aggro. In the event there are multiple Zagaras in a team, they can fully interact with Creep placed by each other.

abilities.name: Baneling Barrage
abilities.description: Launch 2 Banelings that deal 80 damage to the enemies they hit. Stores up to 2 charges.; 4 / 0.125

fields.notes: Banelings explode at the end of their range. Banelings benefit from on-Creep Movement Speed bonus. Enemies that are immune to skillshots can still be hit by the explosion damage.

abilities.name: Devouring Maw
abilities.description: Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 damage per second. yellowtext Usable on Unstoppable enemies.; 80; 70; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Status effect / Pathing blocker
fields.props: Area of Effect, Invulnerable Summon, Stasis (debuff)
fields.notes: Enemies caught by Devouring Maw are put in hostile Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, the targets are also Stunned, have no collision, do not receive the expanded debuff removal, and some delayed heals applied beforehand are prevented. Vehicles are completely unaffected by Devouring Maw. Deathwing cannot be devoured, but his pathing can be blocked by Devouring Maw.

abilities.name: Nydus Network
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 120 Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second. Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time. passive Creep spreads 15% farther. passive While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds. Nydus Worm ; 50; 120 / 2; heroic

fields.notes: Zagara can cast Nydus Network while inside a Nydus Worm. Other Abilities are disabled. Nydus Worms cannot be placed such that they overlap Structures or unpathable terrain or within 6 radius of an existing Nydus Worm. Placing a fifth Nydus Worm causes the oldest one to be destroyed. After being placed, Nydus Worm spreads Creep around it. This does not expire until the Nydus Worm is destroyed. Nydus worm has collision, is Unstoppable and immune to friendly Abilities and does not draw Minion aggro. Entering the Nydus Worm requires a 1.5 second channel that is interrupted upon taking damage. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara is put in Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Zagara is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), has no collision and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed. If all Nydus Worms are destroyed while Zagara is inside, she is ejected at the location of the last one.
